name: Shiva ERP (event-related potential) signal
origin: Shiva software by Todd Murphy (signal templates licensed from Persinger and Koren)
summary: Murphy's simple Shiva ERP session: an event-related-potential-shaped pulse stepped counter-clockwise around the head. Murphy expects 'general cortical effects', likely with more right-hemisphere response, and says the signal 'should be considered as untested'.
setting: Dark, quiet room, eyes closed, relaxed without meditating or falling asleep.
schedule: At most once a week, never on consecutive days; up to 6 sessions, then a 21-day break.
notes: Coils sit on Murphy's Shiva ring (Fp1, FT7, TP7, O1, O2, TP8, FT8, Fp2; one coil per site instead of Shiva's coil pairs) and fire one at a time counter-clockwise seen from above (back-to-front over the right side), 10, 12 … 20 ms per coil (Murphy's lecture example; Shiva's own step table is unpublished). Murphy's ERP file is proprietary and undescribed; this file uses the project's ERP construct (textbook P50, N100, P200, N200 and P300 components after Luck 2014: a 0.6-s pulse every 1.5 s, 1-ms points), not the Shiva file. Counter-clockwise rotation raised right-hemisphere EEG power in a Persinger-lab study (Booth 2008, single-lab), which may be why Murphy expects more right-hemisphere response; that link is the project's inference. Shiva offers 20, 30 and 60-min versions; this file runs 20. Independent double-blind tests of God-Helmet-type fields found no field effect (Granqvist 2005; Gendle & McGrath 2012). Untested signal: stop if it is unpleasant; not for people with epilepsy.
source: Murphy, Shiva demo: ERP signal https://www.god-helmet.com/wp/shiva/shiva_demo/erp_page.htm ; Murphy, Shiva demo: Magnetic coil locations https://www.god-helmet.com/wp/shiva/shiva_demo/locations.htm ; Murphy, Psychic Skills & Miracles lecture (coil steps of 10, 12 ... 20 ms) https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tmC1174POpA ; Booth, Koren & Persinger 2008, Electromagn Biol Med 27:426 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/19037792/ ; Murphy, Shiva demo: Session lengths https://www.god-helmet.com/wp/shiva/shiva_demo/session_length.htm ; Granqvist et al. 2005, Neurosci Lett 379:1 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/15849873/ ; Gendle & McGrath 2012, Percept Mot Skills 114:217 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/22582690/
